correctness.rationale: Pick discriminant isolates exactly (B,I)=(3,1),(3,2),(3,3), with other pairs covered by Wagner. Exact fourth-dimensional finite differences produce H_i. For J≥1, the quartic discriminant after J=1+u has 28 strictly positive coefficients in each of three cases, each provided in the complete integer certificate; a specific negative-point evaluation forces at least two real roots, and positive discriminant forces all four distinct reals. J=0,c>0 cubic discriminants have positive polynomial coefficients; J=c=0 quadratic discriminants are 9,24,57. All numerators have nonnegative coefficients and constant 1, ruling out nonnegative zeros. Checker rederives all identities from the Pick Ehrhart polynomials with exact symbolic arithmetic.

value.rationale: The natural question is whether the product operation repairs the only three types of planar nonreal Ehrhart numerators. The theorem supplies a complete classification for all 4-dimensional Cartesian products of arbitrary polygon factors, demonstrates nontrivial conversion of nonreal inputs to all-real outputs, and proves a universal invariant without width restrictions. It is not the routine Wagner product corollary because the critical hypotheses fail for those three genuine polygon families.
